ἐλευθ-έρια (sc. ἱερά), τά,
A.festival of Liberty, held every four years at Plataea, in memory of the battle there, Posidipp. 29 , D.S. 11.29 , Paus. 9.2.6 , etc.; at Syracuse, in memory of the restoration of the republic, D.S. 11.72 ; at Samos, in honour of Eros, Erxias ap. Ath. 13.562a : generally, “ἐ. θύειν”
Henioch. 5.10
.
II. thanksgiving for liberty,
IG 9(2).1034 (Thess.).
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
